description: This file defines the 'XmlSerializable' interface which specifies methods for serializing objects to XML and deserializing objects from XML within the 'org.apache.ofbiz.entity.serialize' package.

classes.name: XmlSerializable
classes.description: A generic interface for objects that can be serialized to and deserialized from XML format.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts an XML Element back into an object of type T.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the current object into an XML Element.
